title: Canonical prescribed-head FMR timing-fixture qualification
motivation: The frozen h0=-75 cm, hbot=-50 cm full-half timing fixture is canonically rejected for both analytical and adaptive hydraulics through temporal rejection. The timing gate itself is therefore blocked, not failed.
selection_rule: Using analytical/default-off execution only, select the accepted candidate with the largest absolute bottom-head perturbation from -75 cm. Accepted means canonical status COMPLETED, completed=true, at least one accepted substep, zero solver rejections and zero mass rejections.
after_selection: Freeze the selected fixture, then execute a separate adaptive-vs-analytical paired timing workflow. Do not use adaptive outcome or timing data to select the fixture.
